long_biography.plain_text:
Nancy Walton Laurie has directed part of her inherited retail wealth towards dance and arts education. She founded and financed Cedar Lake Contemporary Ballet in New York, whose repertory brought experimental European choreography to American audiences. She also established the Columbia Performing Arts Centre after her daughter’s interest in dance drew her towards the field.

Her work with Chi Omega adds a separate focus on women’s leadership. Laurie is an ex-officio trustee of its foundation, and the organisation named its leadership institute for her support. Her campaign gift was the largest in Chi Omega’s history. The institute now delivers leadership and life-skills training to collegiate and alumnae members nationwide.
